original_source_text: 第四条 住院医疗保险责任：在保险期间内，被保险人因遭受意外伤害或在等待期（30天）后罹患疾病，经中华人民共和国境内二级以上公立医院普通部诊断必须住院治疗的，本公司就其合理且必要的住院医疗费用，在扣除人民币650元免赔额后，按100%给付住院医疗保险金，累计给付金额以40万元人民币为限。
english_translation: Article 4 Inpatient Medical Insurance Liability: During the insurance period, if the insured suffers accidental injury or falls ill after the 30-day waiting period and requires hospitalization diagnosed by a public hospital Class 2 or above in mainland China, the company will reimburse 100% of reasonable and necessary inpatient medical expenses exceeding the RMB 650 deductible, up to a cumulative maximum of RMB 400,000.

provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
original_source_text: 第五条 门急诊医疗保险责任：被保险人因遭受意外伤害或在等待期后罹患疾病，在二级及以上公立医院门诊或急诊接受治疗的，门急诊医疗费用累计达到免赔额650元以上的部分，本公司按85%的比例给付保险金。门诊日限额为人民币600元，保险期间内累计给付金额以2万元为限。
english_translation: Article 5 Outpatient and Emergency Medical Benefit: For outpatient or emergency care at Class 2 or above public hospitals due to accident or illness after waiting period, the company reimburses 85% of eligible expenses exceeding the RMB 650 deductible. The daily outpatient reimbursement cap is RMB 600, and the cumulative maximum per policy year is RMB 20,000.
topic: Outpatient Emergency Benefit, Deductible, and Coinsurance

provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
original_source_text: 第七条 责任免除：因下列情形之一导致被保险人支出医疗费用的，本公司不承担给付保险金责任：（一）被保险人在投保前已罹患的既往症、先天性畸形及遗传性疾病；（二）在公立医院特需医疗部、国际部、外宾病房或私立诊所发生的医疗费用；（三）整容、矫形、视力矫正及非意外牙科治疗。
english_translation: Article 7 Exclusions: The company is not liable for medical expenses arising from: (1) Pre-existing conditions, congenital malformations, and hereditary diseases existing prior to policy inception; (2) Treatment received in public hospital VIP departments, international wings, foreign guest wards, or private clinics; (3) Cosmetic surgery, orthopedics, vision correction, and non-accidental dental treatment.
topic: Policy Exclusions: Pre-existing Conditions and Private Facilities

original_source_text: 深圳大学国际学生入学须知：根据教育部规定，来华留学生必须在入学报到前购买‘来华留学生综合医疗保险’。未购买指定保险者，学校不予办理学籍注册及签证延期手续。保险期间须覆盖在校整个学习周期。
english_translation: Shenzhen University International Student Registration Notice: Pursuant to Ministry of Education regulations, international students must purchase the Comprehensive Insurance & Protection Scheme for Foreigners Staying in China prior to enrollment. Students who fail to purchase will not be registered or assisted with visa extension. Insurance must cover the full study period.

original_source_text: 第二条 重大疾病保险金：被保险人经医院确诊初次发生本主险合同约定的重大疾病（共120种），且此前未发生本主险合同约定的特定轻度重疾或中症重疾的，我们按基本保险金额给付重大疾病保险金，本主险合同终止。等待期为90天。
english_translation: Article 2 Critical Illness Insurance Benefit: If the insured is diagnosed for the first time by an accredited hospital with one of the 120 critical illnesses defined in this policy contract, we pay 100% of the basic sum insured (RMB 500,000) as critical illness benefit, and the policy terminates. Waiting period is 90 days.
topic: Critical Illness 120 Conditions Lump Sum Benefit

original_source_text: 第三条 重大疾病保险金责任：被保险人于本合同生效之日起一百八十日后，经本公司认可的医院确诊初次发生本合同所指的重大疾病（共100种），本公司按基本保险金额给付重大疾病保险金，本合同终止。若因意外伤害导致上述情形的，无等待期限制。
english_translation: Article 3 Critical Illness Benefit: If the insured is diagnosed after 180 days from the policy effective date with one of the 100 defined major illnesses, the company pays 100% sum insured (RMB 500,000). If caused by accident, no waiting period applies.
topic: 100 Severe Diseases Waiting Period and Lump Sum

original_source_text: 第二条 身故保险金：被保险人于本合同生效或最后复效之日起九十日后因疾病导致身故，或因意外伤害导致身故，本公司按基本保险金额给付身故保险金（100万元人民币），本合同终止。
english_translation: Article 2 Death Benefit: If the insured dies due to illness after 90 days from policy inception or due to accidental injury at any time, the company pays the full basic sum insured (RMB 1,000,000), and the policy terminates.
topic: Term Life Death Benefit and Accidental Death

original_source_text: 第三条 意外伤害身故及残疾保险金：在保险期间内，被保险人遭受意外伤害事故，并自事故发生之日起一百八十日内因该事故身故的，本公司按意外伤害保险金额给付身故保险金。因该事故导致残疾的，按比例给付伤残保险金。等待期为0天。
english_translation: Article 3 Accidental Death and Disability Benefit: If the insured suffers an accident and dies within 180 days or incurs disability graded under the national standard, benefit is paid up to RMB 500,000. Waiting period is 0 days.
